Black paint, rounded stroke and proportional padded SVG viewport; original path data and transforms are unchanged.", "credit": "Will Pittenger; GP geometry correction by Sentoan; typography by DooFi", "historicalApplicability": "Visible GP-Strecke path3128 from the July 2013 correction (file history: Real and correct GP layout), including Mercedes Arena and tight NGK chicane. Hidden earlier path3197 is explicitly excluded. 2020 Eifel GP uses this 5.148 km GP route, not Nordschleife.", "license": "Public domain", "licenseUrl": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Template:PD-self", "page": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:N%C3%BCrburgring_-_Grand-Prix-Strecke.svg", "sourceSha256": "6bc686225537b8386f3f9993fe234c82e502b64739609f4cc157b54c507a622c", "url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/76/N%C3%BCrburgring_-_Grand-Prix-Strecke.svg"}
svg.desc: Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
